verdict.rationale: LangSmith is an observability and evaluation platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official first-party MCP server repository (langchain-ai/langsmith-mcp-server) exists, but the pack gives no detail on what it exposes or how an agent connects. Missing for 10: documentation of the tools and resources the server exposes, setup and authentication instructions, transport details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent connecting to it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
